website.note: Corporate site lists biopreservation media, cell processing tools, cryogenic storage, and thawing equipment. No drug or therapy pipeline is disclosed; BioLife is positioned as a bioproduction tools/ancillary supplier to cell-and-gene therapy developers.

ctgov.note: BioLife Solutions sponsors no interventional clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.
